g.text: Processing - the run and per-file orchestrator
Delegates everything --summary prints beyond its own
file counts to two classes that format their own lines
The order PlanFor tests these in is the policy.
Decided once, ahead of the --run-before hook - a file
the run will not touch must not run a hook either -
and read again by CommitOneAsync, so the decision is
reached in one place rather than two that can drift.
deliberately: a separate counter could disagree
with the listing printed under it.
the ordinary per-file pipeline, never woven
into it: a downloaded book is a file on disk like
any other, and detection neither knows nor needs to
detection. In ABS mode the run's own options are used
as they are - a temp folder is no place for a
